summary: To install only security errata on a schedule, use ansible.builtin.dnf with name '*', security: true and state latest in a regularly scheduled job template.
questions: How do I install only security updates with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Install security updates only
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Install all security-related RPM updates
  hosts: target_hosts
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install latest RPMs with security errata
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: '*'
        security: true
        state: latest
```
